name: 7shifts
description: 7shifts is a restaurant team-management platform built for operators and hourly employees. Restaurants use it for scheduling, time clocks, labor compliance, team communication, tasks, manager log books, hiring, onboarding, payroll, tips, sales and labor reporting, and employee engagement.
agentUseSummary: Connect a restaurant company through 7shifts, then choose which agents can read or manage its workforce and operations under Safe or Dangerous policy.

providerSetup.blocker: 7shifts has not yet approved Relay Console as a technology partner or issued its OAuth client ID and secret.
providerSetup.nextAction: Email integrations@7shifts.com with Relay Console's technical contact, company name, logo, and callback https://api.relayconsole.work/api/v1/marketplace/oauth/7shifts/callback. After approval, store SEVEN_SHIFTS_CLIENT_ID and SEVEN_SHIFTS_CLIENT_SECRET in Railway, deploy, grant a test company as its admin, then verify token renewal, company binding, all tool families, revocation, agent assignment, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: 7shifts requires partners to use an approved OAuth client, documents company-admin grant callbacks with guid and company_id, one-hour client-credentials tokens, x-company-guid, and authorization.revoked.
7shifts states that partners must use OAuth Clients and that current authentication methods provide admin-level authority.
